name: Salesforce platform events source connector
description: Eventstream now provides a Salesforce platform events source connector, bringing real-time business events from Salesforce into Microsoft Fabric. This complements change data capture by streaming custom and standard platform events.With this capability, you can:- Stream Salesforce platform events into Eventstream.- Trigger real-time analytics and actions on business events.- Route platform events to Fabric destinations.

result.nameEs: Conector de origen de Salesforce platform events
result.descriptionEs:
Eventstream incorpora un conector de origen para los platform events de Salesforce, que lleva a Fabric eventos de negocio en tiempo real y complementa la captura de cambios:
* Transmite platform events de Salesforce a Eventstream.
* Lanza análisis y acciones en tiempo real.
* Envía los eventos a destinos de Fabric.
